checks.name: E1 sha256(manifest file) == the digest sidecar
E2 rebuilding the body from CURRENT inputs reproduces the file byte-identically (any drift in inputs/tools ⇒ REFUSE ⇒ a NEW epoch is required)
E3s every SERVE-closure binding re-hashes green (S1: a serve edit rotates the epoch)
E3 every identity + tool binding re-hashes green
E4 floor claims == a LIVE representation_floor_gate run; non-authorship stated OPEN; nothing rounded up
E5 NO self-written clock anywhere in the body (the epoch instant is the TSA's)
E6 rebuilding the RFC 3161 query reproduces the stored .tsq byte-identically (the query binds THIS manifest)
E7 S3/S4 claims match the CURRENT receipts

does_NOT_prove: fidelity — a timestamp over a manifest of wrong claims verifies perfectly; fidelity lives in the per-source receipts the claims restate
non-authorship — OPEN on both sources, stated in the manifest itself
equivalence_level: BINDING (sha256 identities) + EXISTENCE-IN-TIME once witnessed; neither is a fidelity level
receipt: GlobalServe S5 gs_release_manifest — EPOCH 1 binding + RFC 3161 witness
